title: Recent row counts: review 0 and gate 0 for relays whose reviewer and gate steps were not recorded; check the duration

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
Owner screenshot 2026-10-28 (ork 2483523+): the Recent row for S162 reads `pass  S162  13h27m  ended 3m ago  impl 1  review 0  gate 0`. Two things to check:

1. The review and gate counts come from the ledger's steps. In this relay the outer session ran the reviewer, UI pass and gate as subagents and did not record ledger steps for them (only the implementer's step and the orchestrator's were recorded), so the counts read 0 although review and gate ran (several rounds). Decide: the outer orchestrator records a step per role round (the relay contract's rule, `slicer ai relay-orchestrator`), and ork's Recent row says so when the ledger holds no review or gate step (for example `review -` instead of `review 0`) or reads the engine record when there is one. Also check what an externally orchestrated relay should show.
2. The duration `13h27m` for a run that landed shortly before: find out how it is computed (run start to end, including a wait overnight?) and whether Recent should show active time instead; verify before changing anything.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body: Re-anchor from the code (Recent rows in relayboard.go). Interview the owner at preflight on the wording and the duration rule. UI slice: UI pass (r14).

sections.heading: Check
sections.body: go test -race ./internal/tui; goldens; go vet; gofmt -l; slicer check; adj lint.
